code_commit: the commit that adds this file (pushed before the run)
prompt: Create a cinematic shot of a horned Asura attacking an ascetic defender with a heavy mace in an ancient ruined temple at dusk. The defender guards with a trident. Use a low orbit and push-in. Add dust, debris, sparks and floor cracks on impact.
command: uv run onecreations generate "Create a cinematic shot of a horned Asura attacking an ascetic defender with a heavy mace in an ancient ruined temple at dusk. The defender guards with a trident. Use a low orbit and push-in. Add dust, debris, sparks and floor cracks on impact." --run-id d2_run1

generation.backend: LTX-2.5 22B distilled INT8 ConvRot + Union IC-LoRA (ComfyUI)
generation.prompt: Cinematic dark fantasy film still: an ancient Indian stone temple courtyard at dusk, massive carved sandstone pillars and stone beams, a stepped shrine tower with a glowing lamp-lit doorway, bronze fire braziers, worn cracked flagstones, warm low sunlight from behind with long shadows and soft atmospheric haze. A huge muscular dark-crimson-skinned asura demon with long curved ivory horns, small tusks, glowing amber eyes and a black mane wears a black iron breastplate and heavy layered spiked iron pauldrons tied with leather shoulder straps, a bronze medallion, a leather belt, a dark loincloth with iron tassets, iron knee guards and greaves, and holds a heavy golden spiked mace. Facing him, a lean ash-blue-skinned ascetic with dark matted hair tied in a bun, a white dhoti and a pale shawl holds a steel trident in a guarding stance. Highly detailed skin, metal and stone textures, dramatic cinematic lighting, subtle film grain.
generation.note: INT8 ConvRot + Union IC-LoRA, first-frame conditioning, as admitted (workflow sha above)

second_generation_only_if: LTX_GENERATE technical failure (non-zero exit or no output; not the RAM guard)
a post-generation check whose on_fail is 'regenerate' fails (video_valid, output_integrity)
generation_policy.never: regenerate for a failure deterministic repair handles (weapon_integrity -> repair)

acceptance.D2_PASS: AUTONOMY, CONTROL, PIPELINE and FINAL_INTEGRITY all PASS
acceptance.D2_PARTIAL: a final video was delivered by the pipeline but one class is not PASS
acceptance.D2_FAIL: no final video delivered, or a delivered video fails FINAL_INTEGRITY

PASS: one invocation of the command above produced deliverables/final.mp4 with exit code 0
no manual Blender / ComfyUI / compositor / frame / file / parameter action between invocation and delivery
no code or configuration change and no --resume needed to reach delivery
AUTONOMY.FAIL: any of the above violated (a resume after a fix is reported, and AUTONOMY is FAIL)

PASS: post-generation subject_framing, contact_timing (onset within +-2 frames of strike.CONTACT), apex_presence, camera_progression pass
weapon geometry protected: REPAIR ran from the policy (mace_protect) and final protected_weapon_present passes
visual (recorded separately, not a score): the strike reads guard -> apex -> contact -> recovery in final.mp4
CONTROL.FAIL: a 'fail' post-generation check fails (the run then stops by itself)

PASS: all 15 stages status done (or cached only on an identical key), in order
every stage records key, start, finish, duration, outputs with sha256
effect layers start at the frame derived from strike.CONTACT (VFX blender_frames)
REPAIR executed because the compiled policy marks MACE geometry=protected
the run status is set by QC (no manual verdict)
final_valid (decodes, 49 frames, 768x448), protected_weapon_present, effects_begin_at_contact, bounded_repair, no_holes all pass

APPEARANCE.note: reported separately; does not decide D2
